notes.content:

notes.title: 📢 Hey, guys! New update based on your feedback
notes.content:
We have just released a new update. We have completely optimized the graphics, so the black curtains and stuttering are gone in Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3.

It is now possible to play on Quest 1 smoothly at any resolution, although it is better to avoid Extreme one as Quest 1 lacks some RAM.  Long live Quest 1! 

The look of the vegetation on the Royal Troon course has been also improved.

We have also fixed a few bugs, e.g. the flag is now visible in the leaderboard on holes 11, 12 and 13 of the Tropical course, and we have eliminated the blurring that sometimes occurred in the leaderboard.
 
Have fun with it!

notes.title: New ROYAL TROON course, available
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES

[list]
[*] New ROYAL TROON course, available at no additional cost to those who subscribe to The Open Zone. We are proud of our work, and it is our hope that you will enjoy it!
[*] A new smaller panel allows seeing the entire horizon in 360 degrees (it will be possible to freely re-position it in an upcoming update). We look forward to hearing your thoughts about it!
[*] The panel is always in view. Just point the laser at the scoreboard and it will be visible above any obstacles.
[*] If the ball is hidden behind an obstacle, pressing the controller's side-trigger will reveal its position.
[*] Improved usability of the course selection menu.
[*] Display of swing data history available to all players using HPC. It is accessible from the "My Swing" button on the player profile screen (cap icon at the top of the screen).
[*] 
If no golf club attachment is selected, the controller will always be displayed in its actual position.
[*] 
It is now possible to jump from one hole to another in putting green and mini-golf practice mode using the hole selector (just like on the Golf Course Practice mode).
[*] There are minor corrections and bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun with it!
The Golf 5 Team
Contact us at users@aaagamestudios.com

notes.title: Update 3.5 New rewards available!
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now register your email from the new "MY DATA" section in the player profile. Still haven't done it? Do it now and get rewarded!
[*] A new PROMO CODES section has been added to the player profile. Promotion codes will be loaded with prizes and benefits.
[*] The Options section has been completely redesigned. Try it out. Access the Options screen by clicking the gear icon at the top right of the screen.
[*] Added new controllers' configuration parameters and new golf club attachments presets for a much better customization.  For example, Meta users can now easily set up the 90º attachments that work with the new Quest 3. Click CONTROLS on the Options screen to try it.
[*] Callaway's Mavrik and Epic club sets now have a better look.
[*] There are minor corrections and bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun with it!
The Golf 5 Team

notes.title: Maintenance, bugfixing and optimization
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*] New colorization has been applied to the greens. Now, the colors range from light yellow to dark red, depending on the slope of the terrain. The redder a slope is, the more stepped.
[*] The 'Retired' status has been added to tournaments.  if the player does not finish the match, he will appear in the ranking as  'RET'. Note a  'RET' counts as a participation, so if the tournament is NON-REPLAYABLE the retired player will not be able to play it again.
[*] Important correction on duration, frequency, options, cost, and prices of all tournaments across all game modes.
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXING[/b]

Among others, fixed issue on the 18th hole of St. Andrews: slopes now appear correctly.

[b]MINOR CORRECTIONS AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

notes.title: The Open on VR
notes.content:
Welcome to the 151st edition of The Open. This edition brings a special surprise... It's the first-ever virtual reality edition! 

Are you ready?
[list]
[*]The VR Open Qualifiers start July 1st!
[*]The VR Open starts July 13th with a surreal replica of the Royal Liverpool course
[/list]

[h2] Graphics [/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved materials for the 3D models of the controllers.
[*] New assets and environments.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented "visualize green lines" effect when the player crouches.
[*] A Brand new Course: Safari, now  with a very special offer: free for 12 months! Just register your email through the Golf 5 mobile app.
[/list]
[h2]VR experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] HTC Cosmos compatibility has been implemented.
[*] New recentering system by pressing the joystick on the controller to enhance the user experience.
[/list]
